title: Curvature integral on convex hypersurfaces
summary: Let $M^n$, $n\ge3$, be the smooth, connected, complete, noncompact boundary of a closed convex set with nonempty interior in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$. We prove that its normalized scalar-curvature integral at infinity is at most $4πω_{n-2}(1-\operatorname{AVR}(M))$, except when, up to an ambient rigid motion, $M$ is the product of a smooth closed convex surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and $\mathbb{R}^{n-2}$. These exceptional products have zero asymptotic volume ratio and limit $8πω_{n-2}$. We also characterize the equality case for the $4πω_{n-2}(1-\operatorname{AVR}(M))$ bound.
